headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Dealing with a Clogged Drain
articleBody:
A clogged drain can be super frustrating, and it's easy to fall into traps that can actually make the problem worse or even create new ones. We see these situations all the time in Las Vegas, so knowing what not to do can save you a lot of headache and expense. One common mistake is repeatedly pouring chemical drain cleaners down the drain. While they might offer a temporary fix, these harsh chemicals can corrode your pipes over time, especially older ones, and they rarely get rid of tough, recurring blockages. Plus, mixing different chemical cleaners can create dangerous fumes! Another big no-no is trying to force tools like a coat hanger into the drain without knowing what you're doing. You can easily push the blockage further down, scratch the pipe, or even puncture it, turning a simple clog into a major repair. Continuing to run water into a backed-up system is also a mistake; it just increases the risk of an overflow and water damage. And please, don't ignore recurring backups. If a drain keeps clogging, it’s not just a routine issue; it suggests a deeper problem like roots, a collapsed pipe, or significant buildup that needs a professional assessment, often with a camera inspection.

When Professional Guidance Helps
When clogs become a frequent issue, multiple fixtures are affected, or you suspect a serious problem like a sewer line issue, it's definitely time to call in a professional.
